bundles.name: eio-b0-fork-bootstrap
bundles.title: Fork infrastructure on the vendored 6.3.0-skytekx.1 base: protocol bump, data-map shim, Curios soft compat
bundles.spec:
STATUS: the vendor, version and license work (old feature id fork-bootstrap) is DONE on claude/twilight-forest-port-mods-j2owbq: 8799e05 (vendor 1.20.1@18ee1b17), dd66c98 (6.3.0-skytekx.1 reproducible Java 17 build), e508261 (NOTICE_enderio, LICENSE_enderio, META-INF/licenses/enderio/*, unofficial mods.toml description). Do not redo it. The jar from e508261 matches the shipped 6.2.18 jar except for f9e1806c/18ee1b17 and the metadata, and eiocompat gives 0 missing for ELM, Exchangers and AllTheLeaks. This bundle adds only infrastructure that later bundles use.

BUNDLE STATUS: DONE in 6a3268f (protocol bump), 90c9f8b (JSON data maps), 10ba7e1 (optional Curios support) and effd892 (review fixes). As built, where it differs from the text below: the data map loader extends SimplePreparableReloadListener and reads every pack's copy through ResourceManager.getResourceStack in pack order, because a SimpleJsonResourceReloadListener only sees the top pack, so neither the merge nor replace could work. The files also take an optional remove list. S2CDataMapSync is the last core packet, so every base, machines and conduits packet id moved up by one. Server-only consumers (machine tasks, tick code) call getServerValue(K), screens and JEI call get(K), because on a physical client an integrated server worker thread counts as the client side. The Curios range is [5.2.0,), since CuriosApi.getCuriosInventory(LivingEntity) first appears in 5.2.0 and the 5.2.0 betas sort below it. CuriosCompat.getActiveCurios returns an empty List without Curios, accepts a null filter and also passes the empty stacks of free slots to the filter, as upstream does. The shipped Curios data is data/curios/tags/items/charm.json and data/enderio/curios/entities/enderio.json, with no slot size. Still open: a real client join that shows the synced values (Vat bundle) and a dedicated runServer with and without Curios.

(1) network-protocol-bump: CoreNetwork PROTOCOL_VERSION "1.0" -> "1.0-skytekx.1" (src/core/java/com/enderio/core/common/network/CoreNetwork.java line 13). Packet ids are assigned by registration order across core, base EIOPackets, MachinePackets and ConduitNetwork. Appending a packet anywhere shifts the later ids, so this bump is mandatory, and later bundles only append registrations at the end of their module's list. The second channel enderio:main (EIONetwork, "1", used only by light nodes) stays unchanged unless a bundle adds a packet there. Commit: chore(enderio): bump the network protocol for the backport.

(2) json-datamap-shim: core/common/data/JsonDataMap<K,V>, a SimpleJsonResourceReloadListener per map, registered on AddReloadListenerEvent (FORGE bus). Folder data/<ns>/data_maps/<item|block>/<name>.json. Upstream format {"replace": bool, "values": {"<id>": {"#<tag>": <number>}}}. Both 8.x maps (vat_reagent: Item -> Map<TagKey<Item>,Double>, range_extender: Block -> Map<TagKey<Block>,Integer>) are per-entry maps of tag to number, so a typed value parser per map is enough. Merge packs in load order and honour replace. Resolve ids lazily and skip unknown ids with a debug log line. Add an S2C full-sync packet on OnDatapackSyncEvent (event.getPlayer()==null means all players), appended at the end of CoreNetwork. Clear the client cache on ClientPlayerNetworkEvent.LoggingOut. If the code reuses SoulDataReloadListener (Commoble, MIT), add the new class to the Commoble entry in ports/enderio/NOTICE and keep the MIT header. No consumers yet. Commit: feat(enderio): JSON data maps for 1.20.1.

(3) curios-soft-compat: in build.gradle add exclusiveRepo(handler, 'https://maven.theillusivec4.top/', 'top.theillusivec4.curios') beside the existing exclusiveRepo lines (line ~207). Add compileOnly fg.deobf("top.theillusivec4.curios:curios-forge:5.14.1+1.20.1") and localRuntime with the same coordinate. This exact artifact is already in ~/.gradle (the TF fork uses that maven). The pack ships curios-forge-5.14.1+1.20.1. Add com.enderio.base.common.integrations.curios.CuriosCompat with a public facade (getActiveCurios(Player, Predicate<ItemStack>) -> List<ItemStack>, empty when Curios is absent) and every Curios call in a nested class that loads only after ModList.get().isLoaded("curios"). Note that CuriosApi.getCuriosInventory(LivingEntity) returns a LazyOptional in 5.x, so call resolve(). Data: data/curios/tags/items/charm.json {replace:false, values:[enderio:staff_of_travelling, enderio:electromagnet]} (ids checked in EIOItems lines 329 and 335) and data/enderio/curios/entities/enderio.json {entities:[player], slots:[charm]}. Do NOT ship a slots/charm.json with a size. 8.x sets size 2, but in the pack Cyclic already defines charm with size 4, Aether's override pack with size 2 and Curios itself without a size, so leave the slot count to them. mods.toml: optional dependency curios versionRange [5.0,) ordering NONE side BOTH. Commit: feat(enderio): optional Curios support.

Test: compileJava. Full build (LC_ALL=C.UTF-8). eiocompat ELM 0 missing. A dedicated runServer reaches Done with Curios and without Curios.

COMMON RULES (identical for every bundle):
- Work in ports/enderio (6.x layout src/{api,core,main,machines,conduits,armory}).
- Never rename or remove registry ids, NBT keys, block-state properties or capability ids. New NBT keys are optional with a default. New inventory slots go after the existing indices. That is safe only because f9e1806c sizes MachineInventory from the layout and ignores the Size key, so never reintroduce Size reads.
- Translation 1.21.1 -> 1.20.1:
  - Data Components -> ItemStack NBT / BlockEntityTag, keeping the 6.x key names from CoreNBTKeys/MachineNBTKeys/EIONBTKeys.
  - Data Attachments -> Forge capabilities.
  - CustomPacketPayload/StreamCodec -> 6.x Packet + Packet.PacketHandler, registrations appended.
  - DeferredHolder/Regilite -> Registrate entries.
  - ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath -> new ResourceLocation.
  - Capability lookups -> getCapability(ForgeCapabilities.X).resolve().
  - Codec JSON -> GsonHelper serializers like the 6.x recipes.
  - c: tags -> forge: tags.
  - Data folders: recipes/, loot_tables/, advancements/recipes/, tags/items|blocks|fluids|entity_types/.
- Forge 47 gaps:
  - No SizedFluidIngredient or FluidIngredient.
  - No 1.20.5+ item tags such as #minecraft:meat (absent from client-extra.jar 1.20.1 and forge-1.20.1-47.4.0-universal.jar).
  - No AddSectionGeometryEvent.
  - No EntityTickEvent: use LivingEvent.LivingTickEvent.
  - No 1.20.5+ content (wind charge, breeze rod, trial chambers).
- Capabilities: Forge's CapabilityTokenSubclass transformer returns the ERASED type name (checked in fmlloader-1.20.1-47.4.0), so CapabilityToken<IFoo<A>> and CapabilityToken<IFoo<B>> are the same Capability. Every new capability needs its own non-generic interface annotated @AutoRegisterCapability.
- Never call setChanged, sendBlockUpdated or neighbour getBlockState from setLevel or onLoad. That is the chunk-load deadlock fixed upstream in 4dd6e5e09 and ef97d54da. Defer it to the first serverTick.
- Client-only classes (Screen, Minecraft, ClientLevel, renderers, KeyMapping, ClientTooltipComponent, BakedModel) stay under */client/** and are registered only from Dist.CLIENT subscribers (RegisterKeyMappingsEvent, RegisterClientTooltipComponentFactoriesEvent, ModelEvent.RegisterGeometryLoaders on the client mod bus). The dedicated server must start. No mixins.
- AllTheLeaks 1.1.1 (local-mods) has @CompatibleHashes mixins into CountedIngredient.getItems and WrappedEnchanterRecipe.getLapis. Never modify those two methods (so do not port 83177fc53). New JEI code copies stacks instead of mutating Ingredient.getItems().
- Inventory Sorter (local-mods inventorysorter-1.20.1-23.0.11) skips only the slot classes named in the IMC in EnderIO.java line 187 (ItemFilterSlot, FluidFilterSlot), matched by class name. Add every new filter or ghost slot class to that IMC.
- 6.x commits datagen output in src/generated/resources, including lang/en_us.json AND en_ud.json. When a provider changes, hand-write the generated files byte-identically to the provider's output, with keys sorted as datagen sorts them. The ship stage runs runData and reconciles.
- Build check before every commit: free -m (wait while available < 4000 MB), then cd ports/enderio && JAVA_HOME=/opt/jdk17 PATH=/opt/jdk17/bin:$PATH ./gradlew compileJava -Porg.gradle.java.installations.paths=/opt/jdk17 -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2g --console=plain -q. Keep the warning settings. A full build needs LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 (no_no<U+200C>.json).
- After every bundle, python3 -I scratchpad/bp2/enderio-tools/eiocompat.py <built -all jar> local-mods/eio_legacy_machines-0.4.9.jar must print TOTAL MISSING: 0. ELM links 10 classes and 21 members: IOMode, Vector2i, ItemStackFilter.test, EntityFilter.test, CapacitorUtil.isCapacitor, EIOCapabilities.FILTER, MachineBlockEntity ctor/getCapability/invalidateCaps/load/saveAdditional/getUpdateTag/onIOConfigChanged, MachineMenu ctor, MachineScreen ctor/init/containerTick/render, IOConfigButton ctor. Do not change these signatures.
- Scheduling: two lanes after b1. The machine lane b2 -> b3 -> b4 -> b8 shares MachineBlocks, MachineBlockEntities, MachineMenus, MachinePackets, MachinesConfig and MachineRecipeProvider. The conduit/filter lane b5 -> b6 -> b7 shares EIOItems filters, filter menus, ConduitBlock and ConduitBundle. b9 comes last. Both lanes edit the generated en_us/en_ud: at integration, merge both sides' keys (or run runData), never take one side.
- Commits: Conventional Commits, scope enderio, types feat/fix/perf/chore/docs only. One concern per commit, with a multi-line why-body that cites the upstream hashes. No em or en dashes, no hyphens used as dashes and no semicolons in messages. Env GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="Florian Kleber" GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=skytekx@erebos.xyz GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Claude GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=noreply@anthropic.com. No trailers. Never push. Never commit build/, .gradle/, run/ or logs. Commit early (the container may restart).
- Per-feature records: scratchpad/bp2/enderio/inventory.json. Where this spec and that file differ, this spec wins.

bundles.spec:
Goal: land the fixes that were verified against the 6.x code before any content.

fluid-tank-dupe-fixes (machines/common/blockentity/FluidTankBlockEntity.java):
- tryTankRecipe (lines ~271-304) shrinks the input before checking the fluid. SIMULATE the fill or drain, require the full recipe.getFluid().getAmount(), then shrink and output (fad146640).
- Re-run recipe.matches(container, level) before executing (1b36f8464, GH-1302). data/enderio/recipes/tank_empty/sponge.json exists in 6.x, so the sponge dupe is live.
- tryMendTool runs only when FLUID_DRAIN_OUTPUT is empty (95fb1e4be). Line ~313 overwrites the output today.
- The bucket drain returns early when stack.getFluid().getBucket()==Items.AIR (500f11729, line ~249).

capacitor-bank-stack-dupe: in machines/common/item/CapacitorBankItem.BlockEntityEnergyStorage, scale receive and extract by getCount() and split the energy per item (7a5e3ebf3). The item stacks to 64, so a stack charges once today and every placed bank carries the full charge.

menu-slot-dupe-fixes:
- GhostMachineSlot.mayPickup=false.
- MachineMenu.doClick (line 178) on ghost slots: return for every ClickType except PICKUP and QUICK_MOVE. Keep the PICKUP replace logic and port the QUICK_MOVE no-op from aba7ff872 (#1458).
- core FilterSlot.mayPickup=false. The filter-slot clear only works with an empty carried stack. Add the ImpulseHopperMenu ghost guard.
- The filter menus base/common/menu/{Item,Fluid,Entity}FilterMenu lock the player slot that holds the opened filter (8c7952cf7).
- Add GhostMachineSlot and PreviewMachineSlot to the inventorysorter slotblacklist IMC (EnderIO.java line 187). Only the filter slot classes are listed today.
- ELM menus extend MachineMenu and inherit these fixes. Its frozen MachineMenu ctor stays.

machine-output-and-io-fixes:
- MachineInventory.snapshot(MultiSlotAccess), used in the CraftingMachineTask.placeOutputs simulation (dccb83cda). Line ~168 simulates each output against the live inventory, so a second output can void.
- TransferUtil.distributeFluids empty-tank pull branch (f600657d8).
- Optional defensive hardening of TransferUtil.moveItems (line 28): extract for real first, then insert, and put a remainder back. Keep the one-item rate. 9d35cace6 and 775f88789 fix 7.1+/8.x whole-stack code that 6.x does not have.

recipe-output-fixes:
- SagMillingRecipe.SizedTagOutput.getItemStack keeps the count (4061eacf8). List the affected shipped recipes in the commit body.
- SoulBindingRecipe.assemble copies the input tag when the output item equals the input item (aa963f47d). This fixes the 6.x powered_spawner rebind recipe from f49ba60d, which loses the capacitor and IO config.
- The mossy cobblestone dupe dc01be82e does not apply: 6.x has no mossy_cobblestone sag_milling recipe (checked all 65 JSON files, none differs in bonus type from 8.x). Say so in the commit body.

small-fixes:
- ChunkBoundLookup.updateForBlockRadius copies currentChunks (69b0bd57f).
- FireCraftingHandler honours InfinityConfig.MAKES_SOUND, which 6.x defines but ignores (4b57a5733).
- TravelHandler.shortTeleport sets Pose.SWIMMING when player.isInWall() after the teleport (59b00dd66, logic only).
- SetLootCapacitorFunction excludes modifiers it already chose (ed55f0d53).
- NEW: AE2 GridHelper.onFirstTick guard `if (!mainNode.isReady()) mainNode.create(...)` (4bb7e90e9). 6.x conduits/common/integrations/ae2/AE2InWorldConduitNodeHost.java line 105 is unguarded, and the pack ships AE2 15.4.12 with ME conduits.

network-packet-hardening (NEW, SkyTekx-original, no upstream commit, both upstream lines have the bug):
- C2SDataSlotChange (core/common/network) and C2SSetConduitExtendedData (conduits/common/network) accept any BlockPos with no reach or loaded check. C2SSetConduitConnectionState and RequestTravelPacket get the same audit.
- level.getBlockEntity on an unloaded pos loads the chunk.
- EnderBlockEntity.serverHandleBufferChange (line 224) trusts the slot index.
- ConduitBlockEntity.handleExtendedDataUpdate (line 118) feeds client NBT into the full deserializeNBT. For energy conduits that sets EnergyStored, an energy dupe for any client today.
- Fix in the handlers:
  - Require level.isLoaded(pos) and player.distanceToSqr(center) <= 64. For travel, keep the TravelHandler range rules.
  - Bounds-check the data-slot index and catch malformed buffers.
  - Apply conduit GUI data only through a new ConduitData.applyGuiNBT(CompoundTag) default that delegates to deserializeNBT, overridden in EnergyConduitData to ignore EnergyStored and EnergyMaxStored.
  - Obelisk and other range data-slot callbacks clamp to getMaxRange().
- One fix(enderio) commit, with an Arclight note: a public server without claim plugins.

Commits: one fix(enderio) commit per feature id. Savegame: none (no key changes).

Test:
- compileJava.
- On a world copy: tank recipes with a nearly full tank, the sponge and wet sponge swap, mending with an occupied output, charging stacked capacitor banks, ghost slots with Inventory Sorter, a SAG mill with two outputs stalled, the powered spawner rebind keeping its capacitor, ME conduits reloading next to an AE2 controller.
- A forged C2SDataSlotChange or C2SSetConduitExtendedData from 100 blocks away is ignored.
- eiocompat 0 missing.

bundles.name: eio-b2-vat
bundles.title: The Vat and its fermenting recipes
bundles.spec:
Goal: the unpowered Vat with its nine recipes. It is also the first survival source of enderio:nutrient_distillation, which ELM's Killer Joe consumes: KillerJoeBlockEntity.NUTRIENT_DISTILLATION = new ResourceLocation("enderio","nutrient_distillation"), compared exactly.

Template and fixes:
- Template: 1cb2e1420 'Add the Vat' (2024-06-30, src/machines layout).
- Then apply b7b355a74 (JEI VATCategory).
- 9aff4169f (#1200, GH-1196): SIMULATE the output-tank fill and EXECUTE only when the full amount fits. The recipe Input carries a FluidStack snapshot, not the live tank.
- e4645aa88 (#1212): FermentingRecipe.matches tries both slot orders, and JEI and transfer follow.
- b1e1ab917 and 4b37b9d86 for the recipes.
- fec605fba does NOT apply (NeoForge data-component codec).

Do not port these parts of 1cb2e1420:
- the MachineFluidHandler save change. 6.x keeps Tanks/Index/Size (MachineFluidHandler lines 28-30, 204-238). 8.x nests TANK_CONTENTS, which would break every existing tank, XP obelisk and soul engine.
- its canExtract gating. 6.x already gates at line 169.

Forge 47 has no SizedFluidIngredient. Add machines/common/recipe/FluidInput(record: Either<Fluid, TagKey<Fluid>>, int amount) with:
- JSON {"fluid":"enderio:hootch"} or {"tag":"minecraft:water"} plus "amount", parsed with GsonHelper
- test(FluidStack)
- network write/read
- JEI display stacks.
The output is a FluidStack JSON {"fluid": id, "amount": n}, like TankRecipe.

Task and machine:
- The 6.x CraftingMachineTask (blockentity/task/CraftingMachineTask.java line 48) places item outputs only. Either add the 1cb2e1420 constructor variants (nullable MachineFluidHandler, nullable outputSlots, early return when outputSlots==null) or write VatCraftingTask, which overrides placeOutputs with SIMULATE then EXECUTE into the output tank. OutputStack already supports fluids.
- The modifier is the product of the reagent multipliers (data map). Upstream stalls forever when that pushes the output above the 8000 mB output tank: cloud seed with packed ice is 9000 mB and with blue ice 81000 mB. Clamp the computed output to the output tank capacity (a SkyTekx deviation, state it in the commit).
- VatBlockEntity extends MachineBlockEntity (unpowered, no capacitor). Two 8 B tanks (input insert-only, output extract-only), two reagent slots.
- Packets VatDumpTankPacket and VatMoveTankPacket, appended to MachinePackets and validated like b1's hardening.
- Block id enderio:vat with menu and BE. Recipe type and serializer enderio:vat_fermenting.
- Reuse MachineTankLayout, TankAccess, ProgressMachineBlock/progressMachine() in MachineBlocks, RecipeCaches and MachinesJEI.

Data (1.20.1 folders):
- data/enderio/recipes/fermenting/{hootch,rocket_fuel,fire_water,cloud_seed,cloud_seed_concentrated,liquid_sunshine,nutrient_distillation,dew_of_the_void,vapor_of_levity}.json. Translate the fluid ids enderio:fluid_<x>_still -> enderio:<x> (Registrate source names, EIOFluids lines 28-67, all nine exist in 6.x).
- Skip liquid darkness and the enderio:amethyst tag (only that recipe uses it).
- Reagent tags data/enderio/tags/items/:
  - seeds -> [#forge:seeds], crops -> [#forge:crops] (both in Forge 47)
  - cloud_cold, explosives, natural_lights, sunflower (sunflower and torchflower), prismarine, blaze_powder, lightning_rod as upstream
  - meat: list minecraft:beef, cooked_beef, porkchop, cooked_porkchop, chicken, cooked_chicken, mutton, cooked_mutton, rabbit, cooked_rabbit and rotten_flesh, because #minecraft:meat is 1.20.5+.
  - wind_charges: the wind charge is 1.21, so fill the tag with minecraft:phantom_membrane so cloud_seed_concentrated stays craftable. This is a SkyTekx default that a datapack can change. Say so in the commit and the okf page.
- Other reagents use forge:dusts/{grains_of_pizeallity,grains_of_the_end,grains_of_prescience,redstone} (all exist in 6.x generated forge tags).
- data/enderio/data_maps/item/vat_reagent.json with the 15 upstream entries (all exist in 1.20.1), read by the b0 JsonDataMap and synced for the screen and JEI.
- Recipe data/enderio/recipes/vat.json plus advancements/recipes/misc/vat.json with forge:gears/iron, forge:ingots/{conductive_alloy,dark_steel,redstone_alloy}, enderio:void_chassis and minecraft:barrel (all present in 6.x).
- loot_tables/blocks/vat.json keeps the tanks via the 6.x machine loot pattern.
- minecraft:mineable/pickaxe and needs_iron_tool.

Assets: blockstate vat (facing plus powered like the 6.x machines), models/block/vat.json and the combined model in the 6.x machine pattern, textures vat_front/back/top.png, gui vat.png (6.x already has a textures/gui/vat.png, replace it as 1cb2e1420 does), sprites vat_cover, move_fluid and void_fluid from the 1.21.1 tip (Unlicense). No sound.

- All nine recipes appear in JEI and EMI. Blue ice does not stall.

bundles.name: eio-b3-obelisks
bundles.title: Inhibitor, relocator and attractor obelisks on the 6.x obelisk base
bundles.spec:
Goal: the three missing obelisks on the 6.x base: ObeliskBlockEntity, ObeliskManager over ChunkBoundLookup, IObeliskManagerCapability and ObeliskManagerAttacher (aversion backport 75bb8b250).

obelisk-framework:
- IObeliskManagerCapability<T> is generic and @AutoRegisterCapability, and Forge erases the token type. A second CapabilityToken<IObeliskManagerCapability<Inhibitor...>> therefore returns the SAME Capability as AVERSION_OBELISK_MANAGER_CAPABILITY, and level.getCapability would hand the aversion manager to the inhibitor code.
- Add non-generic sub-interfaces IInhibitorObeliskManager and IRelocatorObeliskManager (each @AutoRegisterCapability, extending IObeliskManagerCapability<X>). Attach them in ObeliskManagerAttacher as enderio:inhibitor_obelisk_manager_capability and enderio:relocator_obelisk_manager_capability next to the unchanged aversion one.
- ObeliskBlockEntity gets an abstract @Nullable manager hook and registers in setLevel, unregisters in setRemoved and updates in updateLocations centrally. Range changes from setLevel or onLoad never call setChanged or sendBlockUpdated (4dd6e5e09).
- Use BlockPos.containing(x,y,z) instead of new BlockPos((int)x,...) for event positions. AversionObeliskManager line 34 truncates toward zero, so chunk lookups miss at negative coordinates.
- AversionObeliskBlockEntity keeps its NBT and the fixed max range 32. Fix handleSpawnEvent energy (lines 104/107 call consumeEnergy(cost, true) twice, so it never consumes): the second call must use simulate=false. Note this in the commit.

inhibitor-obelisk (f216165c6, d8261275b, a0189250c, 8254bda11, 71328eba8):
- Capacitor-only layout. A FORGE-bus net.minecraftforge.event.entity.EntityTeleportEvent subscriber, with TeleportCommand and SpreadPlayersCommand exempt.
- Cancel when the target or the origin lies in an active obelisk's AABB. Upstream draws no energy per cancel, keep that.
- 6.x TravelHandler line 287 posts EntityTeleportEvent, so travel staffs and anchors are covered.
- Pack mods that post the event are affected inside the range as designed: Mekanism, Tinkers, Ars Nouveau, Iron's Spells, Botania, Apotheosis, Cataclysm, Twilight Forest, Create, cofh/Thermal, Cyclic, endermen and shulkers.

relocator-obelisk (f216165c6):
- MobSpawnEvent.FinalizeSpawn, MobSpawnType.NATURAL only, with the 6.x EntityFilter via EIOCapabilities.FILTER.
- Post EntityTeleportEvent, then set the position with mob.moveTo, not teleportTo. In FinalizeSpawn the mob is not in the level yet (NaturalSpawner adds it after the event), and Arclight wraps teleportTo in Bukkit teleport handling.

attractor-obelisk (461cf0511, 65fe4d639, ef97d54da, d061a0bb6):
- An entity filter slot. A server tick pulls filtered Mobs: PathfinderMob via navigation.moveTo, Slime and Phantom via setTarget(fakePlayer), Ghast and Wither via directPull.
- Skip #forge:bosses unless the config allows it. The range scales with the capacitor, clamped without setChanged.
- 6.x has no machine owner, so use FakePlayerFactory.get(serverLevel, new GameProfile(UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(("enderio:attractor:"+pos).getBytes()), "[EnderIO Attractor]")), created lazily on the first serverTick, never in setLevel or onLoad. The Flux Networks 7.2.1.15 crash is the reason (ef97d54da).

Blocks, menus, configs and data:
- Blocks, items, BEs, menus and screens enderio:{inhibitor,relocator,attractor}_obelisk. The client screens reuse the 6.x AversionObeliskScreen layout (range +/- and visibility). ObeliskBER draws the floating item.
- Configs (MachinesCommonConfig and the energy config): ranges, capacity, usage and attractor_pull_bosses, plus client range colours.
- Recipes from the 1.21.1 tip with c: -> forge: (all forge tags and items verified in 6.x): forge:ingots/energetic_alloy, forge:ingots/soularium, forge:gems/enticing_crystal, enderio:ender_crystal, ensouled_chassis, iron_gear and energized_gear. The relocator is the aversion obelisk plus prismarine.
- Loot tables, pickaxe and iron tags, lang (en_us and en_ud).

Commits: one for the framework, then one per obelisk. Savegame: additive. Managers are runtime only and rebuilt on load. Aversion is unchanged.

Arclight test (owner or boot stage):
- Pearls and chorus are cancelled in range.
- /tp is exempt.
- Whether Bukkit plugin teleports post the Forge event is unverified, so check /home and /tpa if Essentials is present.
- An attractor next to a Flux Networks point survives a chunk reload.
- A world with all four obelisks loads without hanging.

bundles.name: eio-b4-charger-keybinds
bundles.title: Wireless charger with antennas, staff and electromagnet keybinds with Curios
bundles.spec:
Goal: wireless charging and the staff and magnet keybinds. It depends on b1 because small-fixes edits TravelHandler.shortTeleport, and on b3 because of the shared machine registries.

wireless-charger-and-antennas (4ad73fff0, e65b3feb0):
- WirelessChargerBlockEntity (PoweredMachineBlockEntity, EnergyIOMode.Input, capacitor required, default IOConfig PULL). Use 6.x range data slots instead of 8.x ActionRange.

**Structure and ordering**

**Wrong or missing facts**

Capabilities and the obelisks (b3):
- IObeliskManagerCapability<T> is generic and @AutoRegisterCapability. Forge's CapabilityTokenSubclass erases the type argument (disassembled in fmlloader-1.20.1-47.4.0).
- So "attach two more capabilities" would hand the aversion manager to the inhibitor and relocator code. b3 now uses separate non-generic interfaces.
- AversionObeliskManager line 34 builds positions with (int) casts, which round the wrong way at negative coordinates. b3 switches to BlockPos.containing.

The Vat (b2):
- Forge 47 has no SizedFluidIngredient, so b2 adds its own FluidInput.
- #minecraft:meat is 1.20.5+ and is missing from both the 1.20.1 client jar and Forge 47.4.0, so the meat tag lists the vanilla items explicitly.
- The cloud_seed_concentrated recipe needs enderio:wind_charges, and wind charges are 1.21 content. With an empty tag the recipe is dead, so the tag gets minecraft:phantom_membrane as a default.
- The 6.x CraftingMachineTask can only put items into output slots. b2 needs the fluid-output path from 1cb2e1420.
- b2 must not port the MachineFluidHandler save change from 1cb2e1420. It would break every existing tank.
- Upstream's Vat stalls for good when reagent multipliers push the output over the 8000 mB tank: packed ice gives 9000 mB, blue ice 81000 mB. b2 caps the output at the tank size.
- ELM's Killer Joe reads enderio:nutrient_distillation by exact id. The Vat is its first survival source.

Powered spawner (b8):
- Capture mode must write only the entity type (StoredEntityData.of(type)) in the pack's ENTITYTYPE mode (machines-common.toml line 160). Copying the full data dupes held items and villager trades. Upstream's a90e5c512 makes the same split.
- The Mind Killer needs the movement tick handler from 84bfe2477. On Forge 47 that is LivingEvent.LivingTickEvent.
- The same commit has a COPY-mode UUID fix, also ported.

Connected glass (b9):
- javap shows that Athena 3.1.2's AthenaBakedModel does not override getRenderTypes. The connected glass would render solid unless the spec wraps the model in a cutout render type, which b9 now does.

Keybinds and the charger (b4):
- G and M are already bound in the pack. G: Curios, Ars Nouveau, Simple Voice Chat, LittleTiles, GuideME. M: Xaero's World Map, Simple Voice Chat, LittleTiles. Both new keys ship unbound.
- The upstream wireless charger calls sendBlockUpdated from onLoad, the same deadlock pattern upstream fixed for obelisks in 4dd6e5e09.
- The electromagnet and levitation staff already avoid the re-equip flicker through PoweredToggledItem, so only TravelStaffItem and the armory tools need the override.

Curios (b0):
- The 8.x charm slot file sets size 2. Cyclic already defines charm with size 4, so b0 ships no size.
